subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should maintainers narrow this branch back to the pairing authorization-store fix, or intentionally review the broad unrelated dependency/workflow/generated changes in the same PR?
rationale: The pairing fix has a concrete remaining bug, while the live PR also changes many security- and automation-sensitive surfaces that the body does not explain and that cannot be treated as routine pairing fallout.

options.title: Narrow to pairing fix
options.body: Fix the parse-error gap, rebase against main, and keep only the pairing store and focused tests in this PR.

options.title: Review as broad branch
options.body: Keep the unrelated surfaces only if maintainers explicitly want one large integration review covering dependency, workflow, Docker, i18n, app, extension, and runtime changes.

options.title: Pause until split
options.body: Pause this PR until unrelated work is split into separately reviewable branches with matching proof.

recommendation.title: Narrow to pairing fix
recommendation.body: Fix the parse-error gap, rebase against main, and keep only the pairing store and focused tests in this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the current PR branch and has the strongest pairing-store history among the likely owners.
